name: FilterCellsInExcelWorksheet
label: Filter Cells in Excel Worksheet
description: Filters cells in the specified Excel worksheet based on criteria applied to a specific column.

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet object to apply the filter on.

fields.name: FilterMode
fields.label: Filter Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to filter cells: Active Sheet, Specific Range, Named Cells, or Table.

selectOptions.label: Active Sheet
selectOptions.description: Applies filter on the entire active sheet.

selectOptions.label: Specific Range
selectOptions.description: Applies filter on a specified range (e.g., A1:B10).

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column of the range to filter (required if 'Filter Mode' is 'Specific Range').

fields.name: EndColumn
fields.label: End Column
fields.description: The ending column of the range to filter (required if 'Filter Mode' is 'Specific Range').

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row of the range to filter (required if 'Filter Mode' is 'Specific Range').

fields.name: EndRow
fields.label: End Row
fields.description: The ending row of the range to filter (required if 'Filter Mode' is 'Specific Range').

fields.name: NamedCells
fields.label: Named Cells
fields.description: The name of the named range to filter (required if 'Filter Mode' is 'NamedCells').

fields.name: TableName
fields.label: Table Name
fields.description: The name of the table to filter (required if 'Filter Mode' is 'Table').

fields.name: ColumnToFilter
fields.label: Column To Filter
fields.description: The column letter (e.g., 'A', 'B') or number (e.g., 1, 2) to apply the filter on.

fields.name: FilterCriteria
fields.label: Filter Criteria
fields.description: The filter condition to apply. Example: '=Apple', '>10', '<>Complete'.
